descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S14 「现成的 spec：标记和取消标记都存下来，刷新后还在」 Existing spec: a mark and an un-mark are stored and survive a reload

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 2；TFA-92587 How it works 2；TFA-92587 How it works 6）
  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock.（TFA-92587 AC 6；UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given A resident created not In Today

When All Residents → '+ Today' → Today's Visits → reload → All Residents → 'In Today ✓' → Today's Visits → reload

Then The stored flag follows each tap, and Today's Visits shows or hides the resident before and after each reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in panels.spec.ts (snf:list inTodaysSession true / false, Today's Visits after reload). The test does not check that the un-marked resident is still in All Residents; S01 does

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
